newsitem.title: USA: BAB Holdings to merge with muffin company.
newsitem.headline: BAB Holdings to merge with muffin company.

text.p: BAB Holdings Inc said Friday it has a letter of intent to merge with My Favorite Muffin Too Inc, a privately held muffin and bagel cafe company, in a deal that will not exceed $1.8 million in value.
BAB said it expects the deal to be immediately accretive.
BAB said it will give My Favorite Muffin between 320,000 and 444,275 BAB common shares in the deal, plus $125,000 cash. It said it also will assume $400,000 to $450,000 in debt.
The company said My Favorite Muffin has 61 units in 15 states, primarily on the East Coast. BAB operates Big Apple Bagles and had 162 stores before the acquisition.
The company's shares closed down 1/8 Thursday at 3-1/2.
